root.title: Restore ORB-310 development toolchain compatibility
root.description:
Source: https://linear.app/nckrtl/issue/ORB-310/restore-dependency-compatibility-across-the-development-tools
Flow: discovery. Incus: not required.

Orbit's developer tools initialize and execute with the repository's supported dependencies. At main `0a0fdc92b48f65d6944b48cc6a821e9106b6ba82`, CLI Boost application information fails with `Target class [db] does not exist`, Docs bootstrap rejects locked Pest 5.1.3 against the supported 5.1.4 manifest, and twelve E2E Pest-setup tests fail before reaching their intended assertions. The affected inputs remain unchanged on main `31f8f6a2787dd04d2a7145f2154d80344549c86d`.

## Scope

* In: CLI Boost application-information compatibility and its executable regression tests.
* In: Docs development dependency compatibility with the existing pinned Pest setup.
* In: E2E Pest-setup test fixtures and focused regression coverage.
* Out: adding a database to the CLI, disabling Boost tools, changing the Pest patch or version-refusal policy, unrelated dependency upgrades, harness runtime behavior, Incus scenarios, or fleet operations.
* Out: new delivery gates, JUnit reporting, production behavior, or new architecture.

## Acceptance

- [ ] The CLI's `application-info` tool returns valid application context through both its registered MCP identity and the Orbit tool-execution entry point, without resolving a database connection or requiring database configuration. Proof: the CLI `BoostGuidanceTest.php` regression exercised by `composer test:affected` and `php orbit boost:execute-tool 'Laravel\Boost\Mcp\Tools\ApplicationInfo' W10=`.
- [ ] A development install from the Docs lock completes Pest setup and autoload generation using the version supported by the repository manifest; repeating setup succeeds without changing tracked inputs. Proof: `composer install --no-interaction --prefer-dist` twice in `apps/docs`, installed-version inspection, and clean tracked dependency inputs after the lock update.
- [ ] Pest setup's supported-version fixtures reach and pass their intended patching, repeatability, temporary-Git-directory, and interrupted-patch recovery assertions against the supported manifest. Proof: `apps/e2e/tests/Unit/E2E/PestSetupTest.php` exercised through E2E `composer test:affected` with nonzero test execution.
- [ ] Unsupported Pest versions, corrupted package files, and a changed patch checksum still fail explicitly rather than bypassing setup checks. Proof: the negative cases in `PestSetupTest.php` exercised through E2E `composer test:affected`.

## Commander delivery context

Single maintenance repair for the three diagnosed failures described in issue.md. One root group, one executable child: Restore CLI Boost, Docs bootstrap, and Pest fixture compatibility. Work from current main in the inspected native repair worktree adopted by Commander. The child's single objective is restoring this coherent development dependency baseline, not redesigning tooling.

Evidence: Boost2.7.1 ApplicationInfo now calls DB::connection()->getDriverName(); CLI is stateless Laravel Zero with an existing LaravelBoostCompatibilityServiceProvider. Prefer its existing adaptation seam, preserve external application-info identity, and prove both dispatch routes without adding a DB provider. Docs locks Pest5.1.3 while bin/pest-support/manifest.json requires5.1.4. Limit dependency update to Pest and genuinely required transitive packages. PestSetupTest.php writes fake installed.json v5.1.3 before reading the manifest; derive valid fixture version from the authoritative manifest while keeping negative cases distinct. No source edits in main or cache publisher.

This Commander package replaces the legacy .loop planning task list only for this adopted issue. Keep native flow/evidence artifacts; discovery, automated-only, no Incus acquisition. No architecture change or new ADR is needed: restore accepted behavior under ADR0054/0059. Documentation audit should find no changed user contract; report drift if found rather than add documentation for its own sake. Do not modify other accepted candidates or start ORB71/304.

Worker changes source, verifies affected tests through unfiltered TIA and changed-project checks, and yields uncommitted changes with criterion-by-criterion evidence. A retained independent reviewer owns changes requests, approval and one clean commit. Commander then runs the exact clean-candidate Builder gate, and the final reviewer verifies the same receipt without repeating it. The manager publishes, independently lands through the main hold repair authorization, verifies actual recovery on main, then returns to ORB304. Failed bootstrap is an owned environment preparation outcome, not authorization to weaken setup checks.

Acceptance and scope are exactly issue.md. Additional review focus: tool name preservation, no DB resolution hidden by a stub, minimal lock diff, executable supported/invalid fixture branches, no patch/guard weakening. Root acceptance = all four issue criteria plus exact candidate gate and independent integrated review. No browser surface or Incus criterion.

issue.title: Restore dependency compatibility across the development tools
issue.description:
Orbit's developer tools initialize and execute with the repository's supported dependencies. At main `0a0fdc92b48f65d6944b48cc6a821e9106b6ba82`, CLI Boost application information fails with `Target class [db] does not exist`, Docs bootstrap rejects locked Pest 5.1.3 against the supported 5.1.4 manifest, and twelve E2E Pest-setup tests fail before reaching their intended assertions. The affected inputs remain unchanged on main `31f8f6a2787dd04d2a7145f2154d80344549c86d`.

## Scope

* In: CLI Boost application-information compatibility and its executable regression tests.
* In: Docs development dependency compatibility with the existing pinned Pest setup.
* In: E2E Pest-setup test fixtures and focused regression coverage.
* Out: adding a database to the CLI, disabling Boost tools, changing the Pest patch or version-refusal policy, unrelated dependency upgrades, harness runtime behavior, Incus scenarios, or fleet operations.
* Out: new delivery gates, JUnit reporting, production behavior, or new architecture.

## Acceptance

- [ ] The CLI's `application-info` tool returns valid application context through both its registered MCP identity and the Orbit tool-execution entry point, without resolving a database connection or requiring database configuration. Proof: the CLI `BoostGuidanceTest.php` regression exercised by `composer test:affected` and `php orbit boost:execute-tool 'Laravel\Boost\Mcp\Tools\ApplicationInfo' W10=`.
- [ ] A development install from the Docs lock completes Pest setup and autoload generation using the version supported by the repository manifest; repeating setup succeeds without changing tracked inputs. Proof: `composer install --no-interaction --prefer-dist` twice in `apps/docs`, installed-version inspection, and clean tracked dependency inputs after the lock update.
- [ ] Pest setup's supported-version fixtures reach and pass their intended patching, repeatability, temporary-Git-directory, and interrupted-patch recovery assertions against the supported manifest. Proof: `apps/e2e/tests/Unit/E2E/PestSetupTest.php` exercised through E2E `composer test:affected` with nonzero test execution.
- [ ] Unsupported Pest versions, corrupted package files, and a changed patch checksum still fail explicitly rather than bypassing setup checks. Proof: the negative cases in `PestSetupTest.php` exercised through E2E `composer test:affected`.

evidence_files.contents:
Restored stateless CLI Boost application-info execution through the registered MCP identity and Orbit subprocess entry point, updated the Docs lock only to Pest 5.1.4 and required PHPUnit 13.3.2, and made E2E Pest setup fixtures derive their supported version from the authoritative manifest. Added focused CLI regression coverage, preserved all Pest setup guards and negative cases, completed the scoped documentation audit with no maintained-page changes, and left all source changes uncommitted for independent review.

Binding and scope: discovery flow; base and current HEAD 31f8f6a2787dd04d2a7145f2154d80344549c86d; worktree /fast/worktrees/orbit/orb-310; changes intentionally uncommitted. Incus is not required by the assigned contract, so no topology, Node, live fleet, proof, merge, deploy, or external harness runtime was touched. Retained logs are under /tmp/orbit310-implementation.K34eOD.

Acceptance 1 - CLI application-info through both routes without a database: apps/cli `composer test:affected -- --fresh` exited 0 with 775 tests, 775 passed, 4,592 assertions; /tmp/orbit310-implementation.K34eOD/cli-test-affected-final-fresh.log. BoostGuidanceTest executes `Boost::tool(ApplicationInfo::class)`, asserts the registered name `application-info`, asserts the response is successful and contains PHP/Laravel context plus database_engine null, asserts the container has no `db` binding, then executes the upstream ApplicationInfo class through Orbit's ToolExecutor and checks the same context. From apps/cli, exact command `php orbit boost:execute-tool 'Laravel\Boost\Mcp\Tools\ApplicationInfo' W10=` exited 0; parsed observation: isError=false, php_version=8.5, laravel_version=unreleased, database_engine=null, 152 packages; full response /tmp/orbit310-implementation.K34eOD/cli-boost-execute-tool-final.log. The compatibility provider binds the upstream identity to LaravelZeroApplicationInfo; LaravelZeroToolExecutor normalizes only that runtime subclass back to the upstream allowlisted class, so MCP dispatch retains the external name and Boost allowlist while the subprocess resolves the stateless implementation. No database provider or stub was added.

Acceptance 2 - repeatable Docs install at the supported Pest version: from apps/docs, `composer install --no-interaction --prefer-dist` exited 0 twice. Both runs reported nothing to install/update/remove, generated optimized autoloads, reported `Pest monorepo TIA ready (5.1.4, Orbit patch)`, and completed package discovery; logs /tmp/orbit310-implementation.K34eOD/docs-install-1-rerun.log and docs-install-2.log. `composer show pestphp/pest --no-interaction --format=json` exited 0 and reported v5.1.4 at source e68976ea9da26e57ce74bf6ac4d638ded9151771; /tmp/orbit310-implementation.K34eOD/docs-installed-pest.json. composer.json and composer.lock SHA-256 values were identical before, between, and after the two accepted installs: composer.json 82a075c7f2919463fdf7351bf10da240ae6bf69347378a49bbd411b2f0ebbbe7 and composer.lock 920e123455038690f8b125a707f029d06fe3c8d74c17ba2c616f2229be0ed40a; retained docs-inputs-before-install-rerun.sha256, docs-inputs-after-install-1-rerun.sha256, and docs-inputs-after-install-2.sha256. `composer validate --strict --no-interaction` in apps/docs exited 0. Base/current lock comparison shows exactly pestphp/pest v5.1.3 -> v5.1.4 and required phpunit/phpunit 13.3.1 -> 13.3.2; /tmp/orbit310-implementation.K34eOD/final-worktree-status.log.

Acceptance 3 - supported Pest setup fixture behavior: apps/e2e `composer test:affected -- --fresh` exited 0 with 1,525 tests, 1,525 passed, 8,503 assertions against the final submission; /tmp/orbit310-implementation.K34eOD/e2e-test-affected-final-fresh.log. An earlier unfiltered affected run after the fixture and lock repair exited 0 with 31 tests and 444 assertions and explicitly selected tests/Unit/E2E/PestSetupTest.php; /tmp/orbit310-implementation.K34eOD/e2e-test-affected-1.log. The fixture now reads bin/pest-support/manifest.json before writing installed.json and writes `v` plus the manifest version. The executed PestSetupTest cases cover exact patching from outside Git, repository root, checkout subdirectory and linked-worktree subdirectory; selected-package-only changes; repeatability; temporary Git directory isolation; failed-patch recovery; and already-patched linked packages.

Acceptance 4 - setup guards remain explicit: the same final fresh E2E TIA command exited 0 and executed every PestSetupTest negative case. The unchanged negative fixtures still set v5.2.0 for unsupported-version refusal, corrupt a pinned package file for modified-file refusal, inject failed/no-op Git patch processes, append to the disposable patch for checksum refusal, and verify refusal to mutate linked upstream packages. No bin/pest-setup, manifest, patch, checksum, guard, external harness runtime, or version-refusal policy was changed. Logs: /tmp/orbit310-implementation.K34eOD/e2e-test-affected-final-fresh.log and e2e-test-affected-1.log; exact assertions remain in apps/e2e/tests/Unit/E2E/PestSetupTest.php.

Required native preparation verification: from repository root, normal `bin/bootstrap` ran with inherited APP_CONFIG_CACHE, APP_BASE_PATH and APP_KEY unset and the assigned isolated ORBIT_HOME/TMPDIR/TMP/TEMP/COMPOSER_HOME plus sqlite-memory/array/sync/PAO_DISABLE environment. It exited 0. All five projects installed and reported Pest 5.1.4 ready; CLI guidance passed 13 tests/261 assertions, Docs 1/6, Gateway 22/300, E2E 12/136, and SDK 7/115. Log: /tmp/orbit310-implementation.K34eOD/bootstrap-isolated.log.

Changed-project checks: apps/cli `composer check` exited 0: guidance 13/261, Rector passed, Pint passed, PHPStan passed; /tmp/orbit310-implementation.K34eOD/cli-composer-check-final.log. apps/docs `composer check` exited 0: guidance 1/6, strict docs lint zero findings, Rector/Pint/PHPStan passed; /tmp/orbit310-implementation.K34eOD/docs-composer-check.log. apps/e2e `composer check` exited 0: guidance 12/136, Rector/Pint/PHPStan passed; /tmp/orbit310-implementation.K34eOD/e2e-composer-check.log. Final `git diff --check` exited 0.

Documentation audit: `composer docs-context -- --component=apps/cli --component=apps/docs --component=apps/e2e` exited 0; /tmp/orbit310-implementation.K34eOD/docs-context.log. Reviewed the routed maintained pages and searched maintained docs for Boost, Pest, Composer install and dependency statements. docs/tech-stack.md remains accurate; docs/reference/implementation-loop.md already states the manifest-backed Pest setup, supported refusal/recovery behavior, and TIA commands. No user contract or maintained documentation drift was found, so no docs page changed. Root `composer docs-build` exited 0 and root `composer docs-lint` exited 0 with zero issues/errors/warnings; logs docs-build.log and docs-lint.log.

Observed failures and corrections: initial apps/cli `composer guidance:check` exited 1 with 12/13 passing because the assigned ApplicationInfo path returned an error; fixed and final checks pass. Baseline apps/e2e `composer test:affected` exited 2 with 1,511/1,525 passing, 13 failures and one error: twelve assigned supported-fixture failures plus Docs' incomplete vendor/autoload state; /tmp/orbit310-implementation.K34eOD/e2e-baseline-test-affected.log.
